description:
Get a link to upgrade the account to Pro (raises the monthly quota).

        Returns a Stripe Checkout URL for the human to open and pay — no pingwa
        password needed, the card is handled by Stripe. If the account is already
        on a paid plan, returns a billing-portal URL to switch tier, change Team
        seats or cancel instead. Also lists every way forward with its price,
        cheapest first: a one-time message pack for a low-volume number, Team
        seats, the next plan.
name: upgrade
